sources.name: NASA API portal (api.nasa.gov)
sources.notes: Authenticated APOD request verified the key path. api.nasa.gov is the keyed NASA API gateway; lunar products are hosted by NASA subdomains below.

sources.name: NASA Image and Video Library
sources.notes: Site image metadata and thumbnails. Coverage is sparse for some small polar features.

sources.name: NASA/JPL Horizons
sources.notes: Topocentric Sun and Earth apparent azimuth/elevation for a user-defined site on the Moon (body 301), 2026-11-14 to 2027-11-14, 1 h step.

sources.name: LOLA south-pole 87.5°S+ DEM, 5 m/px
sources.credit: NASA LRO LOLA / NASA Moon Trek
sources.notes: Used for Shackleton elevation, local slope, 5 km horizon model, and hillshade.

sources.name: LOLA south-pole 75°S+ DEM, 30 m/px
sources.credit: NASA LRO LOLA / NASA Moon Trek
sources.notes: Used for Nobile/Connecting Ridge elevation, local slope, 5 km horizon model, and hillshade.

sources.name: LOLA global DEM, 256 ppd (~118 m/px)
sources.credit: NASA LRO LOLA / NASA Moon Trek
sources.notes: Used for Von Kármán and Vallis Schröteri. Resolution is unsuitable for landing-hazard certification.

sources.name: LROC NAC stereo DTM, Marius Hills, 2 m/px
sources.credit: NASA LRO LROC / NASA Moon Trek

sources.name: LROC NAC DTM, Apollo 17, 5 m/px
sources.credit: NASA LRO LROC / NASA Moon Trek
sources.notes: Covers the Taurus-Littrow valley; used for elevation, slope, horizon, and hillshade.

sources.name: Moon Trek south-polar PSR catalogue
sources.notes: Centroid/area catalogue, not polygons. PSR edge distance is therefore an equivalent-area approximation.

sources.name: LRO WAC global and south-polar mosaics
sources.credit: NASA LRO LROC / NASA Moon Trek
sources.notes: Basemap images for the local dashboard.

sources.name: Artemis candidate-region and lunar landing-site literature
sources.notes: Context for Nobile/Connecting Ridge and polar site trade studies. Curated scores are analyst judgments informed by this literature, not measurements.

sources.name: NASA/LROC mission and site documentation
sources.notes: Site geology and data-availability context. Curated scores are analyst judgments.

sources.name: LROC NAC stereo DTM / orthophoto (placeholder)
sources.notes: Needed at 1-2 m/px for final hazard and pinpoint certification.

sources.name: LOLA 5-20 m DEM outside the south-pole cap (placeholder)
sources.notes: Needed for Von Kármán and Vallis Schröteri; the global 256 ppd DEM is too coarse for landing hazards.

sources.name: LEND water-equivalent hydrogen (placeholder)
sources.notes: Needed to turn PSR proximity into an ice-probability estimate.

sources.name: Diviner thermal maps / temperature time series (placeholder)
sources.notes: Needed to replace the qualitative thermal score.

sources.name: Mini-RF CPR / radar roughness (placeholder)
sources.notes: Needed to test whether PSR surfaces contain ice-bearing regolith.

sources.name: Ground truth and traverse data (placeholder)
sources.notes: Apollo 17 traverse profiles and Chang'e-4/Yutu-2 data for algorithm validation.

sources.name: Relay communications link budget (placeholder)
sources.notes: Needed for Nobile/Shackleton and mandatory for Von Kármán.
